heading: Get phone support
intro: Request an AI-assisted support call. Your identity is verified before order details are discussed.
issueHeading: What do you need help with?
consentText: I ask the store to call me with an AI support assistant about this order. This allows up to two attempts in seven days, at least 24 hours apart. The call is processed by AI and may be transcribed temporarily. I can revoke consent at any time from my signed-in customer account or order-status page.
errorConsent: Consent is required before a call can be requested.
errorGeneric: We could not complete that request. Try again or contact the store.
errorNetwork: Check your connection and try again.
callPrepared: A call is being prepared for {{phone}}.
verificationHelp: Give this one-time code only after the assistant identifies the store and explains that it is an AI service.
callActive: The support call is in progress. Stay on the line.
statusReview: The store is reviewing the support result.
orderSupportBody: Use Get support for {{order}} to request a consent-based AI support call.
